By 1200 Seljuk power was at an end everywhere except in Anatolia where they were
challenged by Mongols. In 14th Century one of the Beyliks, reunited Anatolia to make the
journey to the Ottomans.
Legacy
Seljuk brought material and cultural prosperity. Architecture and the arts flourished
in the region by developing an advanced political state. Ottoman Empire and the Turkish
Republic are socially,economically,and religiously indebted to the Seljuk Empire.
